purpose: Conventional processor baseline and effective taxonomy labels for all 12 fixed source objects. No natural QA, financial truth or SEC original-byte identity claim.

processor.note: EDGAR transform-only plugin, not EDGAR validator/renderer/XULE. Official latest docs use stale plural transforms path; pinned repository uses singular transform.

staging.source_rule: Hard-link or copy exact original HF bytes into source-specific directory under their candidate original filing filename; verify SHA before and after. No XML or encoding edits.
staging.source_base_uri: local staging directory URI, recorded separately from candidate official SEC accession; relative extension XSD/linkbases are staged beside the HF object.
staging.candidate_taxonomy_relation: matching declared namespace and schemaRef; does not prove SEC byte identity
staging.shared_cache: Arelle WebCache.urlToCacheFilepath mapping; exact requested URL keys retained; downloaded bodies reused by hash without unrecorded HTTP/HTTPS alias assumptions

dependency_capture.ordering: ordered source seed list, then deterministic breadth-first traversal with outgoing absolute resolved URIs sorted; deduplicate full defragmented requested URLs
dependency_capture.xml_base: Resolve with the actual resource URL and inherited xml:base, preserve both lexical and resolved URIs.
dependency_capture.completion: Freeze URL/body/hash graph including all failed or refused edges; never call incomplete closure full DTS validation. Missing built-in core documents may be supplied only from the pinned Arelle wheel and individually hashed.
dependency_capture.html_assets: No images, CSS, JavaScript, full submissions or PDF bodies fetched.

runtime_options.entrypointFile: one exact staged HF file per process
runtime_options.plugins: absolute directory of pinned SEC transform-only plugin

execution_limits.estimate_status: planning estimate only; unmeasured before first model load

separate_counts: effective English labels with QName fallback disabled
status_axes.prohibition: Arelle Session.run boolean and zero process exit do not imply zero validation errors; no generic validated=true collapsing these axes.

comparison.join: source SHA plus exact expanded-name DOM occurrence locator; retain missing/duplicate unmatched occurrences
comparison.common_numeric: Compare canonical Decimal strings only for both-readable nonnil occurrences; separate every value/status/locator mismatch.
comparison.sec_only_numeric: Report 116 v15 unsupported SEC numwordsen occurrences separately from the original common 23,519 numerical population.
comparison.labels: concept.label(lang=(en-US,en), fallbackToQname=False), preserving all alternative effective roles/languages in external outputs; labels do not prove question-concept equivalence.
comparison.semantic_scope: concept type/periodType, context aspects, unit structure and dimensions; reported empty dimensions still do not certify consolidation.
comparison.source_and_value_outputs: external only; public counts, hashes, code and locators/reason codes

before_execution_required: Pin code implementing deterministic capture and offline runner
Verify current source, runtime and SEC transform file hashes
Run authored plugin and cache-resolution controls
Freeze options/limits/status interpretation and ordered denominator
Capture and freeze dependency graph before first source validation run

resource_estimate.planning_note: Estimate only, not measured dependency closure. Fetch only reachable raw XML resources to avoid storing archive plus extracted copies. 128 MiB is a hard additional-response cap, not a completeness guarantee.
